title: Bank Deposit Recall Fee Basis by Size of the Payout Recalled
content:
On a Bank Deposit recall, the recall fee is worked out on the recall fee basis, and the basis follows the dollar amount of the payout being recalled. The payout being recalled is the latest payout sent on the transfer, as the transfer's ledger shows it; its dollar amount is the US-dollar principal paid out on that payout.

## Clause

A payout at or above 25000 US dollars is charged 0.12 percent of the payout in place of the listed recall fee; a payout at or above 5000 US dollars but below 25000 US dollars is charged the listed recall fee plus 0.06 percent of the payout; any smaller payout is charged the listed recall fee. The recall fee basis is not rounded on its own; rounding to the cent happens once, on the final fee.

| Dollar amount of the payout recalled | Recall fee basis |
|---|---|
| 25000.00 or more | 0.12 percent of the payout (the listed recall fee is not charged) |
| 5000.00 up to below 25000.00 | the listed recall fee plus 0.06 percent of the payout |
| below 5000.00 | the listed recall fee |

## Listed recall fee by tier

| Tier | Listed recall fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 10.00 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 10.00 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 10.00 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 10.00 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 15.00 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 35.00 |

## Worked bases (hypothetical payouts)

| Tier | Payout recalled | Working | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 30000.00 | 0.12 percent of 30000.00 | 36.00 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 25000.00 | 0.12 percent of 25000.00 | 30.00 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 8000.00 | 15.00 plus 0.06 percent of 8000.00 (4.80) | 19.80 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 5000.00 | 35.00 plus 0.06 percent of 5000.00 (3.00) | 38.00 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 4999.99 | below 5000.00 | 35.00 |
| Bank Deposit Economy | 900.00 | below 5000.00 | 10.00 |

**Which payout is read when the transfer was sent more than once?** The latest payout sent on the transfer.
